# Vendored `fluent-egui` (Fluent 2)

Upstream: [fluent-egui](https://crates.io/crates/fluent-egui) 0.1.

Kept as the **widget / runtime base**. Rectangular control & overlay corner radii
were forced to **0** so the shell matches **Fluent 1 / Win10** (see `/home/rong/Win10UI`
`--w10-radius-*: 0`). Toggle knobs, radio dots, and slider thumbs remain circular.
